companyContext: Lucasfilm Ltd. LLC is a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company and a global leader in film, television, and digital entertainment. Founded by George Lucas in 1971, Lucasfilm is best known for creating and producing the Star Wars and Indiana Jones franchises. The company's offerings include cutting-edge visual effects and audio post-production through Industrial Light & Magic and Skywalker Sound, digital animation through Lucasfilm Animation, immersive storytelling, and the management of global merchandising activities for its entertainment properties.
brandName: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
brandContext: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu is the next chapter in the Mandalorian saga, marking Star Wars' theatrical return after a seven-year absence from cinemas. Continuing the story from the acclaimed Disney+ series The Mandalorian (2019–2023), the film follows legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin (Pedro Pascal) and his young Force-sensitive apprentice Grogu as they are enlisted by the fledgling New Republic for a high-stakes mission. Directed by Jon Favreau and co-written with Dave Filoni and Noah Kloor, the film also stars Sigourney Weaver as Colonel Ward and Jeremy Allen White as the voice of Rotta the Hutt. The score is composed by Ludwig Göransson. Opening exclusively in theaters and IMAX on May 22, 2026, it is the first entry in a new slate of Star Wars theatrical films and is part of the Star Wars 'Most Wanted' marketing campaign.

typography.fontUses: Primary display wordmark — 'MANDALORIAN' and 'GROGU' title treatment. Heavy, angular, slightly narrowed sans-serif with rough hand-hewn edges evoking carved stone or beaten beskar metal. Features purple-to-gold gradient fill for the movie version. Includes character silhouettes embedded within letterforms.
'Star Wars' franchise title lockup and the introductory 'A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away...' crawl text. Used across all Star Wars theatrical releases since The Force Awakens (2015).
Body text, editorial content, marketing copy, and descriptive text on starwars.com and official print materials. Clean, readable, modern sans-serif for long-form content at 16px base.
Subheadings, call-to-action buttons, navigation elements, and promotional taglines such as 'Only in Theaters May 22' and 'Get Tickets Now'.
Secondary display and supporting headline text for promotional materials, merchandise, and event signage. Provides visual continuity with the primary Mandalorian wordmark.
Captions, metadata, credit lines, and small supporting labels. Used at 12–14px for fine print, cast listings, and legal notices.

brandVision: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu represents the dawn of a new era for the Star Wars franchise on the big screen. The brand vision is to deliver an accessible, emotionally resonant, and visually spectacular theatrical experience that honors the legacy of Star Wars while opening a new chapter for audiences both familiar and new. The film positions the beloved 'clan of two' — Din Djarin and Grogu — as the franchise's most welcoming on-ramp for the next generation of fans, blending the intimate character-driven storytelling of the Disney+ series with the scale, grandeur, and cinematic spectacle of a major theatrical event. The purple-to-gold visual identity signals a progression from the TV series into a grander, more regal chapter — purple representing wisdom and cinematic scope, gold representing vengeance and legacy in Mandalorian armor tradition. The brand bridges the gap between the space western roots of The Mandalorian and the mythic, galactic adventure audiences expect from Star Wars on the big screen.
brandValues:
Family and Found Belonging — At its core, the Mandalorian story is about the bond between a warrior and his adopted child. Family is not defined by blood but by choice, loyalty, and sacrifice. This value permeates every aspect of the brand, from storytelling to marketing that welcomes families and multi-generational audiences.

Honor and Duty — The Mandalorian creed of 'This is the Way' represents an unwavering commitment to one's principles. The brand stands for integrity, perseverance, and doing what is right even when the path is difficult.

Adventure and Discovery — The Star Wars galaxy is vast and full of wonder. The brand celebrates the thrill of exploration, the excitement of new worlds, and the courage to venture into the unknown.

Craftsmanship and Authenticity — From Lucasfilm's pioneering StageCraft LED technology to practical animatronic effects for Grogu, the brand values real craftsmanship and innovation in storytelling. Every detail — from beskar armor to score composition by Ludwig Göransson — reflects a commitment to excellence.

Inclusion and Accessibility — The film is intentionally designed so audiences who have not watched the TV series can still enjoy and understand the story. The brand welcomes everyone into the Star Wars galaxy.

Legacy and Evolution — Honoring the timeless legacy of George Lucas and Star Wars while boldly evolving the franchise forward. The Mandalorian and Grogu represents continuity with the franchise's 50-year heritage and the promise of new stories to come.
